work_history.title: Account Manager
work_history.description:
Lead integrated marketing campaigns aligned with brand objectives, coordinating across creative, production, and client teams to drive brand growth and market presence. Manage project delivery timelines, budgets, and resource allocation while providing strategic recommendations to optimize brand performance and client satisfaction.

• Directed integrated campaigns for key FMCG and consumer healthcare clients, ensuring alignment with brand growth strategies and communication goals
• Managed end-to-end client servicing including briefing, coordination with creative and production teams

work_history.title: Assistant Account Manager
work_history.description:
Supported multi-channel campaign execution and brand strategy development, collaborating with creative and production teams to deliver marketing assets that strengthen brand positioning. Conducted market and consumer research to inform campaign planning and contributed to new business development through strategic presentations.

• Coordinated execution of multi-channel campaigns across traditional and digital platforms to support brand visibility and consumer engagement
• Contributed to new business growth by assisting in the preparation of integrated marketing strategies and pitch

work_history.title: Senior Account Executive
work_history.description:
Served as liaison between clients and internal teams to ensure brand consistency and timely delivery of marketing projects. Supported brand strategy formulation and client presentations to enhance brand positioning and campaign impact.

• Acted as primary client contact to coordinate campaign execution ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and timely delivery
• Maintained brand consistency and content accuracy across all project deliverables to uphold brand integrity
• Assisted in developing brand strategies and preparing creative presentations to support client decision-making

work_history.title: Account Executive
work_history.description:
Supported digital marketing campaigns including content planning, social media coordination, and reporting. Handled client communication, requirement gathering, and project tracking activities.

• Supported digital marketing campaigns including content planning, social media coordination, and performance reporting.
• Managed client communication and internal project tracking
• Assisted teams in executing digital deliverables within defined timelines
